args.body: Dear Landlord, thank you for your email. First, a correction to our 17 Feb email: it said no issues were found. The attached report does record two things: (1) a dog flap fitted in the back door/utility room, and (2) marks from sticky strips on the Bedroom 1 wall by the window, which the tenant is to remove and make good. Our records do not show any approval for the dog flap, and they do not show a lock change or who holds a spare front door key. We are asking the tenant who fitted the flap and changed the lock, and when, and will ask for a spare key to be sent to us. Please let us know by 22 Feb: (a) whether you approved the dog flap, and (b) whether you or anyone for you changed the lock or hold a spare key. Your email is signed Felix Clarke but our landlord record names Oliver Bennett, so please confirm who you are/your relationship to the property. We will update you by 22 Feb.
